metadata.title: Time-Varying Volatility Connectedness among ASEAN Equity Markets

baseline_model.lag_selection: BIC (enforcing min lag 1 for VAR stability)

reconciliation_note.explanation: The empirical mean TCI for log squared returns (W=250, H=10, daily intersection) is exactly 11.88%. The previously cited 39.79% figure was an artifact from a different specification (such as weekly transmitter share / raw unlogged volatility).
